# augmented brain

> Your brain, augmented with AI. augmented brain gives an AI assistant (Claude Code today) memory, a method and a guard: it remembers your tasks, decisions and people from one session to the next, works through tasks with a method, and asks before touching anything risky. Everything is plain Markdown files of yours, backed up to your own git. Free, MIT, alpha; Linux and macOS.

Install with one command, which asks the language, offers to install what is missing (git, Claude Code, the Claude desktop app), creates two spaces (work and personal) in ~/augmented-brain and opens Claude:

    curl -fsSL https://github.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh

The first session is a short guided interview. A session outside every space's folder (such as a new session in the Claude desktop app with no folder chosen) uses the personal space.

- [How it works](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/how-it-works.md): the four layers, a session step by step, where every file lives, spaces, backup
- [Connect your services](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/connect-services.md): calendar, mail, documents and Jira through MCP
- [Memory format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/spec/memory-format.md): folders, note headers, configuration, backup
